# RDLC Code Authentication Test

This is a synthetic MIT-licensed publishing probe maintained by the RDLC Code
contributors. It verifies registry authentication and delivery of one prebuilt
VSIX to Visual Studio Marketplace and Open VSX.

This package is **not the RDLC editor**. It contributes only an empty light-theme
definition, has no executable extension code, and provides no report authoring
features. Installing it is unnecessary for using RDLC Code.

The same version is never intentionally overwritten. Source and the controlled
authentication procedure are in the RDLC Code repository.
